question: Under what condition is even the wise person said to be burning, according to this description?
premises: A practice involving the tip of nectar is in question.
It is done with the tip of essence.
Even the wise person, while doing so, is described as burning.
inference: Even the wise person, burning, acts at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence.
uncertainties: Exact technical referent of amṛta+agra and rasa+agra remains context-dependent.
plain_english: At the tip of nectar, with the tip of essence, even the wise person, while burning, does this.
